chapter_description.p: Read and write EDF, EDF+, BDF and BDF+ biosignal files.

The European Data Format (EDF) and its 'plus' extension (EDF+) are the interchange formats every sleep, EEG and Holter system reads and writes; BDF and BDF+ are BioSemi's 24-bit variants. This module owns the binary format in one place and returns a domain-free struct, so a reader that gets the header arithmetic, the little-endian samples or the 24-bit assembly wrong cannot return a signal that looks plausible and is wrong. It is designed to be a dependency of higher-level toolboxes rather than to interpret the signals itself.
